Hi, I don't think I posted this yet (sorry if a repeat)

I sent  immigration and asylum lawyer Chris Tiederman the Toolkit piece and she wrote back June 24 fyi <@U05RTFC5UP7> <@U02DXRYCD2N> 

"What a great article and what horrifying times.  I'm sending the article to my non-Sanctuary clients who have been here for over two years.  They carry their various papers with them, but suggestion of carrying evidence that they've been here more than two years is a good one I had not known about. "
